info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Knowledge Assets Management Manual-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of banking knowledge assets within a streamlined framework. It enables organizations to efficiently construct, update, and curate manuals that serve as essential resources for operational excellence in banking. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions, compliance teams, and training departments seeking to enhance their documentation and knowledge sharing processes. By leveraging this API, users can ensure that critical information is well-organized and easily accessible, promoting better decision-making and compliance adherence.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new management manual within the knowledge assets. The operation involves submitting a request with the necessary details to establish a comprehensive guide for management processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update a management manual asset. It must contain details such as the title, content, and associated metadata necessary for managing knowledge assets effectively.
